summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc, a foreign private issuer, reporting the submission of its annual report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. The press release attached announces that the annual report has been filed with the SEC and is available on the SEC and company websites. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, tender offers, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, or management changes. This is a routine regulatory filing with no deal terms, recommended actions, or structural changes. No further analysis or risk-arb angle is warranted.
